name: Nychthemeron
tagline: A poetic exploration of day and night, light and darkness.
story: Nychthemeron creates a contemplative experience that bridges day and night cycles through interactive, thoughtfully designed web interactions. The site exemplifies how the web can be a canvas for artistic expression, using minimalist design and purposeful interactivity to guide visitors through themes of time, perception, and the passage from dusk to dawn. It demonstrates that a website doesn't need elaborate features to be memorable—just clear intent, beautiful restraint, and a compelling idea executed with care.

name: Low-tech Magazine
tagline: A solar-powered magazine about sustainable technology.
story: Low-tech Magazine is a great example of a website whose design follows its subject. Its solar-powered server can go offline when the battery is low, turning energy use into part of the reading experience instead of hiding it behind a dashboard. The site is thoughtful, unusual, and useful: it makes research about technology feel tangible, and its constraints give the publication a character that a polished media template could never provide.
